principle: Authority is earned by capability. Autonomy is not one global permission bit, and it can be revoked.

levels.auto: The agent may do this without asking. Deterministic, reversible, or read-only.
levels.supervised: The agent may do this and must report it. Reversible, but it changes state Lane relies on.
levels.approval_required: The agent may prepare it in full and must stop at ready_for_lane_decision.
levels.lane_only: The agent may calculate, recommend and sequence it. It may never execute it, and may never record it as decided.

review_rule: A capability's authority rises only on measured performance, never on an agent's assessment of its own reliability. Any authority may be revoked at any time.

grants.why: Deterministic and reversible; verified by known-answer tests.
Detecting a conflict is not resolving one.

grants.action: prepare readiness, pulse, attention, verification reports
draft a recommendation with evidence coverage

grants.why: Read-only, least-privilege scope, zero writes asserted.

grants.why: Reversible, but Lane plans on it. Changes are reported and diffable.
